title: Whispers of the Midnight Living Room

sentences.text: At 03:00, a ghostly presence began to waft through the living room, evidenced by the humidity rising to 41.2 %.
This spectral breath on the glass lasted until 06:00, peaking at 05:40.
Later, at 04:20, the house detected a cold spot arriving in the living room.
By 05:00, this cold spot reached its peak, dropping the temperature to 16.6 °C, significantly below the expected 18.0 °C.
